headline: JK Tyre receives Rs 95 crore GST show-cause notice from Chennai tax department
hook: Tax liability adds pressure on margins

The exact grounds for the tax demand were not detailed in the initial filing. Such regulatory notices create potential contingent liabilities for automotive manufacturers. Indian retail investors should monitor how this tax dispute progresses as it could impact the company's near-term profitability.
